# Jordan Yan · AI Documentation

> Technical writing samples by Jordan Yan, Technical Writer II at Zone 5 Technologies: an AI model card, a RAG tutorial, an API reference and an LLM evaluation rubric, plus a defense maintenance work package and an interface control document. All samples are original work; the systems, part numbers and data in them are fictional. No CUI, export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) or proprietary information is included. The Projects page covers ask-my-docs (a tested RAG tool with an MCP server), the Gainwell Technologies EDI companion guides, and the Jungle Decision Framework documentation site.

Every sample opens with an "About this sample" box (audience, document type and standard, approach, how it was checked). The checks run in GitHub Actions on every change: the tutorial's code is executed, the ICD byte layout and the rubric's math are recomputed, and the OpenAPI file is linted and compared with the API reference page. Source: https://github.com/kopyk/ai-docs

## AI documentation

- [Model card: SKYSWEEP FOD Detector](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/ai/model-card): Intended use, per-condition performance, training data, failure modes and mitigations for a fictional runway debris detector, mapped to the DoD AI Ethical Principles and the NIST AI RMF 1.0.
- [Tutorial: build a Q&A bot over your docs](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/ai/rag-tutorial): Step-by-step retrieval-augmented generation in Python with the Claude API; the code blocks are tested in CI.
- [API reference: POST /v1/classify](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/ai/api-reference): Request and response fields, examples in curl, Python and JavaScript, errors, and rate limits for a fictional document-classification endpoint, with a matching OpenAPI 3.1 file.
- [LLM evaluation rubric: documentation Q&A](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/ai/eval-rubric): Pass/fail grading criteria, test-set design, a scored example, and results reported by question type.

## Defense and aerospace

- [Maintenance procedure: UAS propeller replacement](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/defense/maintenance-procedure): A MIL-STD-40051-2 work package with MIL-STD-38784B WARNING, CAUTION and NOTE advisories, prerequisites, numbered steps, and follow-on maintenance for a fictional small UAS.
- [Interface control document: air vehicle status message](https://ai.jordanyan.com/docs/defense/interface-control-document): Byte-level layout of a fictional 32-byte telemetry message with units, scale, ranges, an enumeration, a bitfield, and requirements traceability.

## Projects and about

- [Projects](https://ai.jordanyan.com/projects): ask-my-docs (56 tests, CI, Recall@4 10/10, MCP server, changelog), the Gainwell Technologies DC Medicaid EDI companion guides (Technical Writer, Feb 2025 – Feb 2026) with links to the published PDFs, and the Jungle Decision Framework site.
- [About](https://ai.jordanyan.com/about): Jordan Yan, Technical Writer II at Zone 5 Technologies in San Luis Obispo, California, previously Technical Writer at Gainwell Technologies; B.A. in English, University of Houston; work status, how the site is built, and contact details.
